verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover non-interactive CLI use in depth. Print mode (`-p`) with `--force` handles scripting, and `CURSOR_API_KEY` auth avoids interactive login. Output comes as json/stream-json with non-zero exit codes on failure, and there is a GitHub Actions recipe, service-account auth for cron and CI, and permission tokens for the agent. An SDK is also available for calling the agent programmatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that headless mode works reliably in real scripts.
